svg.aria-label: Set a list element, on disk. Give the element at a random index a new value — an element of its own, not a delete and an insert. Each library's own persistence on node:fs, every write awaited. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: syncom (the pure build: only its text is typed through openText()); Yjs (no element of its own to set); Yjs (memory only — on disk the Yjs row stores every update already); Loro (memory only — on disk the Loro row appends every update already); TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (Node.js disk storages are Premium); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (no list that merges by position); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
